name: Summer Chrome
occasion_en: For days you'll miss in December.
occasion_vi: Cho những ngày bạn sẽ nhớ khi tháng Mười Hai về.
simpler_description_en: Sunlight that stays golden instead of glaring white, under a sky that keeps its blue. Faces hold their warmth while everything around them cools off.
simpler_description_vi: Ánh nắng giữ sắc vàng thay vì chói trắng, dưới bầu trời vẫn còn xanh. Gương mặt giữ được độ ấm trong khi mọi thứ xung quanh dịu lạnh đi.
current_description: Midday sun comes back warm rather than white, and the sky behind it keeps its blue instead of bleaching out. A white wall or a windscreen rounds off gently at its brightest edge, and faces hold their warmth while the rest of the frame cools away from them.

name: Ha Noi Chrome
occasion_en: For humid mornings in the old streets.
occasion_vi: Cho những buổi sáng ẩm trong phố cũ.
simpler_description_en: Made for muggy city light: a white sky that isn't blank, soft damp walls, and shopfront blues and greens that stay themselves.
simpler_description_vi: Dành cho thứ ánh sáng ẩm đặc trưng của thành phố: bầu trời trắng nhưng không trống, những bức tường ẩm mềm đi, còn sắc xanh lam và xanh lục của mặt phố vẫn giữ đúng chất của chúng.
current_description: A white, humid sky that still has an edge to it, damp brick and render with the hardness taken off, and the blues and greens of shopfronts and water staying apart instead of running into one another. The weight of the picture sits low, under a sky that is never allowed to go blank.

name: Amber 400
occasion_en: For the last hour of golden light.
occasion_vi: Cho giờ vàng cuối cùng trong ngày.
simpler_description_en: Late, warm light made gentle. Bright things get a soft glow, skin stays warm, and nothing burns out or falls to black.
simpler_description_vi: Ánh sáng muộn và ấm được làm dịu lại. Những vùng sáng có quầng nhẹ, da vẫn ấm, không gì cháy trắng hay chìm hẳn vào đen.
current_description: Late warm light printed soft: nothing burns out, nothing falls to black, and anything bright enough — sunlit hair, a glass — spreads a little glow around itself. Skin runs warm and gentle while the sky behind it sits heavier.

name: Chrome 50
occasion_en: For strong sun and stronger colours.
occasion_vi: Cho nắng gắt và màu sắc còn gắt hơn.
simpler_description_en: Colour at full weight: deep reds, dark greens, a sky that darkens instead of washing out. Dense, bold and a little severe.
simpler_description_vi: Màu sắc lên hết độ nặng: đỏ sâu, xanh lá đậm, bầu trời tối lại thay vì bạc đi. Dày, mạnh và hơi nghiêm.
current_description: Colour at its heaviest: red that stays red in full sun, green that goes deep rather than bright, and a sky that darkens toward the top of the frame instead of washing out. The dark parts close up rather than opening, so the picture reads dense and a little severe.

name: Nineties Gold
occasion_en: For evenings that feel like old albums.
occasion_vi: Cho những buổi tối giống như album ảnh cũ.
simpler_description_en: A warm snapshot straight from a shop machine: strong colour, peachy light that spreads a little too far, and faces it flatters every time.
simpler_description_vi: Một kiểu ảnh chụp nhanh ấm áp như vừa rửa ở tiệm: màu đậm, ánh đào lan hơi quá tay, và đặc biệt nịnh da.
current_description: A warm snapshot: strong colour, peach through the bright parts, and light that spreads out of them further than it should. The darkest corners never quite arrive at black, so it reads like a print from a shop machine rather than a scan, and faces are flattered by it.

name: Slate 100
occasion_en: For grey days you choose on purpose.
occasion_vi: Cho những ngày xám mà bạn cố tình chọn.
simpler_description_en: Cold, quiet colour for flat skies: pale blues, soft texture, nothing pretending to be sunny.
simpler_description_vi: Màu lạnh, yên và dịu dưới bầu trời phẳng: xanh nhạt, bề mặt mềm, không cố giả vờ là một ngày nắng.
current_description: Cold, quiet colour under a flat sky: blue stays pale and lifted, purples fall away, and nothing anywhere looks sunlit. Concrete, cloth and cloud all keep their texture, and the weight of the picture stays low in the frame.

name: Harbour Neg
occasion_en: For wet weather and standing water.
occasion_vi: Cho ngày mưa và những vũng nước đọng.
simpler_description_en: The water carries the picture: sea-greens and cyans come up strong while every edge goes soft, so a wet grey day feels calm instead of cold.
simpler_description_vi: Nước là thứ dẫn dắt bức ảnh: xanh biển và cyan nổi rõ trong khi các đường nét mềm đi, khiến một ngày xám ướt trở nên bình yên thay vì lạnh lẽo.
current_description: Water and greenery carry the picture — sea-green and cyan come up strong while everything else stays ordinary — and no edge in it is hard. Surfaces go soft and faintly warm, so a wet, shaded scene feels calm rather than cold.

name: Velour 160
occasion_en: For quiet afternoons indoors.
occasion_vi: Cho những buổi chiều yên tĩnh trong nhà.
simpler_description_en: Like a print left in the sun: muted colour, grey-soft blacks, one even warmth over everything. Skin comes out pale and smooth.
simpler_description_vi: Như một tấm ảnh in để lâu dưới nắng: màu dịu, vùng đen mềm thành xám, và một lớp ấm đều phủ lên mọi thứ. Da lên sáng và mượt.
current_description: A print left too long in the light: colour muted but not gone, blacks sitting at grey, and one even warmth over the whole frame rather than two. Skin comes out pale and smooth, and the picture keeps the same level weight corner to corner.

name: Ember 800
occasion_en: For nights that get a little messy.
occasion_vi: Cho những đêm hơi lộn xộn một chút.
simpler_description_en: Firelight and bulbs come back hotter than they were, glowing into the dark around them. Everything leans warm; the night stays dark.
simpler_description_vi: Ánh lửa và bóng đèn hiện lên nóng hơn thực tế, phát sáng vào vùng tối xung quanh. Mọi thứ ngả ấm, còn màn đêm vẫn giữ độ sâu.
current_description: Firelight, bulbs and tail lights come back hotter than they were, spilling glow into the dark around them while the dark itself stays dark. Nothing cool survives anywhere — even the shadows lean warm, and a face by a fire takes the heat straight.

name: Noon Neg
occasion_en: For when the light is already perfect.
occasion_vi: Cho lúc ánh sáng vốn đã hoàn hảo.
simpler_description_en: The honest one: white whites, open shadows, a little extra colour and no mood pushed on top. The photograph, not the recipe.
simpler_description_vi: Một kiểu màu trung thực: trắng vẫn là trắng, vùng tối mở, màu nhỉnh hơn một chút nhưng không ép thêm tâm trạng. Là bức ảnh, không phải hiệu ứng.
current_description: An honest photograph with a little more colour in it: whites stay white, shadows stay open, the corners stay as bright as the middle, and nothing is pushed toward a mood. It is the plain reading the rest of the catalogue departs from.

name: Tungsten
occasion_en: For rooms lit by lamps.
occasion_vi: Cho những căn phòng chỉ có ánh đèn.
simpler_description_en: Keeps a lamp-lit room looking normal — white walls white, skin right — while the world outside the window turns cold blue.
simpler_description_vi: Giữ căn phòng dưới ánh đèn trông tự nhiên — tường trắng vẫn trắng, da vẫn đúng màu — trong khi thế giới ngoài cửa sổ chuyển sang xanh lạnh.
current_description: A room lit by bulbs comes out neutral — white walls white, skin normal — while the window and everything beyond that light turns cold blue. The lamps themselves bloom, and a face beside one keeps its detail instead of burning away.

name: Carbon Mono
occasion_en: For hard light and harder lines.
occasion_vi: Cho ánh sáng cứng và những đường nét còn cứng hơn.
simpler_description_en: Black and white with real black in it: sharp shadows, clean edges, no glow anywhere. Built for buildings.
simpler_description_vi: Đen trắng với sắc đen thật: bóng gắt, cạnh rõ, không quầng sáng. Sinh ra cho kiến trúc.
current_description: Black and white with real black in it: hard shadow against a bright wall, edges that stay edges, and nothing glowing anywhere. The grey sits close to neutral rather than cool, which is what separates it from Silver Mono on the same film.

name: Silver Mono
occasion_en: For soft grey days in black and white.
occasion_vi: Cho những ngày xám mềm trong đen trắng.
simpler_description_en: Long, cool greys that hold the brightest cloud and the darkest coat in one frame. Gentle and open; nothing bites.
simpler_description_vi: Dải xám lạnh kéo dài, giữ được cả mây sáng nhất lẫn chiếc áo tối nhất trong cùng khung hình. Dịu và thoáng, không có gì quá gắt.
current_description: Black and white that holds the brightest cloud and the darkest coat in one frame, in long, cool greys with soft edges. Nothing in it bites, the shadows stay open, and the film's blue-grey tone is left in rather than pulled out.

name: Pastel 100
occasion_en: For pale mornings and soft things.
occasion_vi: Cho những buổi sáng nhạt màu và mọi thứ mềm mại.
simpler_description_en: Everything a shade lighter and quieter, with a whisper of pink in the whites. One warm thing can still sing in a chalky frame.
simpler_description_vi: Mọi thứ sáng hơn và yên hơn một chút, với chút hồng rất nhẹ trong vùng trắng. Một chi tiết ấm vẫn có thể nổi bật trong khung hình phấn nhạt.
current_description: Everything a shade lighter and quieter than it was, with a faint pink through the whites and bright areas that fade away rather than burn to white. Yellows keep more of themselves than anything else, so one warm object can still sing in a chalky frame.

name: Meadow 200
occasion_en: For long grass and open country.
occasion_vi: Cho đồng cỏ dài và những khoảng trời rộng.
simpler_description_en: Grass and leaves become the brightest thing in the frame, warm instead of cold, under a sky that holds itself together.
simpler_description_vi: Cỏ và lá trở thành phần sáng nhất trong khung hình, ấm thay vì lạnh, dưới một bầu trời vẫn giữ được độ rõ và chiều sâu.
current_description: Grass and leaves become the brightest thing in the frame and lean yellow-warm rather than cold, so a field lightens instead of deepening. Blades and branches stay separate from one another instead of merging into a single mass, and the sky above them holds.

name: Verdant Chrome
occasion_en: For forests darker than the sky.
occasion_vi: Cho những khu rừng tối hơn cả bầu trời.
simpler_description_en: Green goes deep, cold and heavy. Foliage turns darker than the sky above it, and nothing warm is allowed to compete.
simpler_description_vi: Sắc xanh đi sâu, lạnh và nặng. Tán lá tối hơn bầu trời phía trên, và không màu ấm nào được phép tranh phần chú ý.
current_description: Green goes deep, cold and heavy rather than bright, leaving foliage darker than the sky behind it. Inside that mass the individual branches stay readable, and nothing red or orange in the frame is allowed to compete with the green.

name: Rust Neg
occasion_en: For old paint and dry ground.
occasion_vi: Cho lớp sơn cũ và mặt đất khô.
simpler_description_en: Everything warm collapses into one oxidised rust, greens go strawy, and nothing in the frame reads as new.
simpler_description_vi: Mọi gam ấm dồn về một sắc gỉ oxy hóa, xanh lá chuyển sang màu rơm, và chẳng thứ gì trong khung hình trông mới mẻ.
current_description: Dry ground, old paint and corroded metal: the warm end of the frame collapses into one oxidised colour and greens turn olive and strawy. Blue is held right down, so nothing anywhere in the picture reads as fresh or cool.

name: Dusk 400
occasion_en: For twenty minutes after sunset.
occasion_vi: Cho hai mươi phút sau khi mặt trời lặn.
simpler_description_en: The after-sunset sky, kept: pink and violet in the clouds, a smooth fade from top to bottom, and ground you can still read.
simpler_description_vi: Giữ lại bầu trời sau hoàng hôn: hồng và tím trong mây, chuyển sắc mượt từ trên xuống dưới, còn mặt đất vẫn đủ sáng để nhìn rõ.
current_description: The sky twenty minutes after sunset: pink and violet held in the cloud, the top of the sky separating cleanly from the bottom, the whole gradient smooth rather than stepped. The ground underneath stays readable instead of sinking into mud.

name: Nightshade 800
occasion_en: For cold streets after dark.
occasion_vi: Cho những con phố lạnh sau khi trời tối.
simpler_description_en: Deep blue night with visible grain. Only the lamps glow, and a face keeps just enough warmth to stand out.
simpler_description_vi: Đêm xanh sâu với hạt film hiện rõ. Chỉ có đèn phát sáng, còn gương mặt giữ vừa đủ độ ấm để tách khỏi khung cảnh.
current_description: A cold street after dark: the sky goes deep blue, the dark stays dark, and only the lamps themselves bloom. Grain sits visibly across the whole frame, and a face keeps just enough warmth to read against everything else that has gone blue.

name: Magic Hour
occasion_en: For staying outside five minutes longer.
occasion_vi: Cho lúc bạn muốn nán lại ngoài trời thêm năm phút.
simpler_description_en: Shoot into the low sun: gold runs through everything the light touches, and the sun keeps its shape instead of blowing out. People stay their own colour.
simpler_description_vi: Chụp ngược nắng thấp: sắc vàng chạy qua mọi thứ ánh sáng chạm vào, còn mặt trời vẫn giữ được hình khối thay vì cháy trắng. Người trong ảnh vẫn giữ đúng màu da.
current_description: Shot into low sun: gold runs through everything the light touches and the sun keeps its shape instead of flaring into a white hole. Faces are deliberately held back from the warmth, so a person stays the right colour while the field around them turns.

name: Neon Night
occasion_en: For staying out too late.
occasion_vi: Cho những đêm về quá muộn.
simpler_description_en: Lit signs keep their colour instead of burning white, and spill it onto the wet pavement. Between them, the dark stays dark.
simpler_description_vi: Biển hiệu sáng vẫn giữ được màu thay vì cháy trắng, rồi hắt màu xuống mặt đường ướt. Giữa những vùng sáng ấy, bóng tối vẫn thật sự tối.
current_description: Lit signs keep their colour instead of burning to white in the middle, and what they spill onto wet pavement comes back coloured too. Between them the dark is hard and empty, and faces stay ordinary so the signs are the only loud thing in the frame.

name: Acid Cross
occasion_en: For rolls developed wrong on purpose.
occasion_vi: Cho những cuộn film cố tình tráng sai.
simpler_description_en: Every colour slides one door down — grass toward teal, red toward orange, blue toward purple — like a roll developed in the wrong chemicals.
simpler_description_vi: Mỗi màu trượt sang màu kế bên — cỏ về teal, đỏ về cam, xanh lam về tím — như một cuộn film được tráng bằng sai hóa chất.
current_description: Every colour has slid to the one next door — grass toward blue-green, a red door toward orange, a blue wall toward purple — and faces slide with them. Whites pick up a green tinge, the shadows pool magenta, and the whole thing reads as a roll developed wrong rather than a treatment.

name: Sepia Mono
occasion_en: For things that were already old.
occasion_vi: Cho những thứ vốn đã mang vẻ cũ kỹ.
simpler_description_en: A warm brown-toned print that looks like it has aged for decades. Best on still subjects and old surfaces.
simpler_description_vi: Một bản in nâu ấm như đã già đi hàng chục năm. Hợp nhất với chủ thể tĩnh và những bề mặt cũ.
current_description: A warm-toned print: brown through the dark parts, easing to a lighter warmth as the picture brightens. The middle greys sit where a print's do rather than a negative's, and the whole image reads as something that has aged.

name: Dream Haze 400
occasion_en: For memories more than moments.
occasion_vi: Cho ký ức nhiều hơn là khoảnh khắc.
simpler_description_en: Light spreads until the whole frame glows and colour drops to half. Soft, pale and dreamlike — skin is the last colour standing.
simpler_description_vi: Ánh sáng lan ra đến khi cả khung hình phát sáng và màu giảm còn một nửa. Mềm, nhạt và mơ màng — da là màu cuối cùng còn trụ lại.
current_description: Light spreads out of the bright parts and keeps going, so the whole frame glows and the dark parts never close. Colour drops to about half of what it was, and skin is the last thing still holding any — pale and smooth in a picture that has given up.

name: Scarlet Sky Mono
occasion_en: For big skies and bold shapes.
occasion_vi: Cho bầu trời lớn và hình khối mạnh.
simpler_description_en: A near-black sky with white clouds standing clear of it. The most graphic look in the catalogue: shapes first, tones second.
simpler_description_vi: Bầu trời gần như đen với mây trắng tách rõ. Đây là kiểu hình ảnh đồ họa nhất trong bộ sưu tập: hình khối trước, sắc độ sau.
current_description: A near-black sky with white cloud standing clear of it, foliage gone dark, and skin a good deal lighter than you expect. It is the most graphic photograph in the catalogue: shapes first, tones second.

name: Fern Mono 200
occasion_en: For gardens in black and white.
occasion_vi: Cho khu vườn trong đen trắng.
simpler_description_en: Turns the usual around: leaves come out bright against dark walls, every vein readable, and the sky settles down to grey.
simpler_description_vi: Đảo ngược cảm giác quen thuộc: lá sáng lên trước tường tối, từng gân lá vẫn rõ, còn bầu trời hạ xuống thành xám.
current_description: Black and white that turns the usual around: a hedge comes out bright against a dark house and leaves keep their veins, while the sky settles to mid-grey. Where Scarlet Sky Mono blackens a sky to make cloud, this lifts the greenery and lets the sky come down to meet it.

name: Grit 1600
occasion_en: For nights too dark to bother — almost.
occasion_vi: Cho những đêm tối đến mức gần như chẳng đáng chụp.
simpler_description_en: Hard blacks, hard whites, coarse grain over all of it. A face becomes a shape. Brutal on purpose.
simpler_description_vi: Đen cứng, trắng cứng, hạt thô phủ khắp khung hình. Gương mặt trở thành một hình khối. Cố tình thô ráp.
current_description: Blacks and whites with very little between them, coarse grain over all of it, and corners that close in on the frame. A face becomes a shape rather than a set of tones, and the bright end runs straight into white with no easing.

name: Soft Matte 400
occasion_en: For quiet scenes left quiet.
occasion_vi: Cho những khung cảnh yên tĩnh được giữ nguyên sự yên tĩnh.
simpler_description_en: Black and white that refuses to be dramatic: soft greys, detail everywhere, nothing sharpened. Leaves a scene as calm as it found it.
simpler_description_vi: Đen trắng không cố tạo kịch tính: xám mềm, chi tiết ở khắp nơi, không tăng độ sắc. Giữ khung cảnh bình thản như lúc bạn nhìn thấy nó.
current_description: Black and white that refuses to be dramatic: grey where another recipe would give black, detail hanging on everywhere, and no extra bite put into the edges. The one monochrome here that leaves a scene exactly as quiet as it found it.

name: Selenium Mono
occasion_en: For cold light and quiet subjects.
occasion_vi: Cho ánh sáng lạnh và những chủ thể yên tĩnh.
simpler_description_en: A cool-toned print: blue-violet in the dark parts, easing lighter as the picture brightens. Sepia's winter cousin.
simpler_description_vi: Một bản in tông lạnh: xanh tím nằm trong vùng tối rồi dịu dần khi ảnh sáng lên. Người anh em mùa đông của Sepia.
current_description: A cool-toned print: blue-violet sits strongest in the dark parts and eases toward a plainer blue as the picture lightens. It is Sepia Mono read cold — the same movement of tone, run the other way round.

name: Snowglass 100
occasion_en: For snow, ice and white winters.
occasion_vi: Cho tuyết, băng và mùa đông trắng xóa.
simpler_description_en: Winter kept crisp: snow and cloud hold their edges, blues run deep enough to tell ice from water from sky, and faces don't go bloodless.
simpler_description_vi: Mùa đông được giữ sắc nét: tuyết và mây vẫn có ranh giới, xanh đủ sâu để phân biệt băng, nước và trời, còn da không bị nhợt nhạt.
current_description: A cold slide film worked the way winter asks: no headroom spent, so the shadows stay clean, and the highlights held back so snow and cloud keep their edges instead of running together. Blue is pushed hardest, which is what separates ice from water from sky. Skin is given a little back, so a face in this light does not go bloodless.

name: Sunday Room 200
occasion_en: For lazy mornings with someone.
occasion_vi: Cho những buổi sáng lười biếng bên một người nào đó.
simpler_description_en: A portrait look and nothing else: soft all over, warm like a room rather than the sun, kind to faces in any light. Works on pets too.
simpler_description_vi: Một kiểu màu dành cho chân dung: mềm toàn khung, ấm như căn phòng chứ không như nắng, và luôn dịu với gương mặt. Chụp thú cưng cũng rất hợp.
current_description: A portrait recipe and nothing else. The bright end is pulled well back and the dark end opened, so a face has room at both ends, and the whole picture is deliberately soft — no edge put back, nothing sharpened. The warmth is a room's rather than the sun's. It works the same way on an animal.

name: Petal Morning 100
occasion_en: For the first weeks of spring.
occasion_vi: Cho những tuần đầu tiên của mùa xuân.
simpler_description_en: Thin spring light kept thin: young leaves lifted, pinks and pale yellows staying light, the sky keeping its air. The softness is the point.
simpler_description_vi: Giữ nguyên thứ ánh sáng xuân mỏng nhẹ: lá non sáng lên, hồng và vàng nhạt vẫn nhẹ tênh, bầu trời giữ được độ thoáng. Sự mềm mại chính là điểm nhấn.
current_description: Built for the weeks when the light is thin. Young leaves are lifted rather than deepened, pinks and pale yellows stay light, and the sky keeps its air. Nothing is forced — the softness is the point, and a scene with strong colour in it will simply be left gentle.

name: Harvest 400
occasion_en: For turning leaves and low sun.
occasion_vi: Cho lá đổi màu và nắng thấp.
simpler_description_en: Autumn gathered up: greens go olive, everything warm pools into one deep rust, and the low sun stays held. A little grain, because the season isn't clean.
simpler_description_vi: Gói cả mùa thu vào một khung hình: xanh chuyển olive, mọi gam ấm dồn thành một sắc gỉ sâu, còn nắng thấp vẫn được giữ lại. Có chút hạt, vì mùa thu đâu có sạch sẽ hoàn hảo.
current_description: Autumn, and the work is in the greens: leaves turn toward olive while the warm colours gather into one deep rust, so a turning tree reads as a single mass of colour against a darker sky. Two whole stages of headroom are spent holding a low sun, and the grain is there because the season is not a clean one.

name: Night Ferry 800
occasion_en: For humid nights full of signs.
occasion_vi: Cho những đêm ẩm đầy biển hiệu.
simpler_description_en: Warm, humid neon: lifted blacks, glow let loose, coarse grain. The air between you and the lights is part of the picture.
simpler_description_vi: Neon ấm và ẩm: vùng đen được nâng lên, quầng sáng được thả tự do, hạt thô hiện rõ. Cả lớp không khí giữa bạn và ánh đèn cũng trở thành một phần của ảnh.
current_description: Humid neon. The blacks are lifted rather than crushed, the glow is let run, and the grain is coarse — a night that is warm and close rather than sharp. Reds and signage carry; the edge is taken off so the air between you and the lights is part of the picture.

name: Electric Rain 800
occasion_en: For rain, LEDs and midnight.
occasion_vi: Cho mưa, đèn LED và nửa đêm.
simpler_description_en: The colder kind of night: crisp wet streets, blue-white signs, deep blacks and a short glow. Sharp where Night Ferry is soft.
simpler_description_vi: Kiểu đêm lạnh hơn: đường ướt sắc nét, biển hiệu xanh trắng, vùng đen sâu và quầng sáng ngắn. Sắc ở đây rõ và gọn hơn Night Ferry.
current_description: The other kind of night: colder, cleaner and sharper. Blacks close up instead of lifting, the light is read as colder so LED signage comes out blue-white rather than amber, and the edges are pushed so wet streets stay crisp. The glow is kept short, and the grain is finer than its warmer neighbour's.

name: Old Quarter 200
occasion_en: For streets older than you.
occasion_vi: Cho những con phố lâu đời hơn cả bạn.
simpler_description_en: Midday in the old streets: yellow walls go mustard, reds fade back to brick, and the humidity stays in the picture.
simpler_description_vi: Buổi trưa trong phố cũ: tường vàng chuyển mustard, đỏ lùi về màu gạch, và hơi ẩm vẫn còn nguyên trong khung hình.
current_description: Old streets in the middle of the day. Yellow walls go to mustard, greens toward moss, reds fade back toward brick, and the blacks are lifted so the humidity in the air stays in the picture. The whole frame is warmed a touch without being turned orange.

name: Sunwash 200
occasion_en: For summers that feel remembered.
occasion_vi: Cho những mùa hè mang cảm giác như ký ức.
simpler_description_en: A holiday photo that has sat in a drawer: soft highlights, open shadows, colour faded a little, warmth turned up.
simpler_description_vi: Một tấm ảnh kỳ nghỉ như đã nằm trong ngăn kéo lâu năm: vùng sáng mềm, bóng mở, màu hơi phai và độ ấm được đẩy lên.
current_description: Summer remembered rather than summer seen. The highlights are pulled down until they go soft, the shadows open, the colour comes off a little, and the warmth goes up — the look of a holiday photograph that has sat in a drawer. Soft throughout, with a little grain in it; nothing here is sharp.

name: Whisker 200
occasion_en: For the cat. Or the dog.
occasion_vi: Cho mèo. Hoặc chó.
simpler_description_en: Built for fur: white coats don't burn out, black coats don't disappear, and every whisker stays a whisker.
simpler_description_vi: Tạo riêng cho lông thú: lông trắng không cháy sáng, lông đen không biến mất, và từng sợi ria vẫn giữ được độ rõ.
current_description: Built for fur, which asks the two hardest things at once: hold a white coat before it burns out, and open a black one before it fills in. Both are pushed as far as they go here. The fine texture is lifted rather than smoothed away — fur without it reads as one grey mass — and the greens are kept low so a bank of grass does not take the animal sitting on it.

name: Lake Mist 400
occasion_en: For fog on the water.
occasion_vi: Cho sương phủ trên mặt nước.
simpler_description_en: A cold morning mist kept misty: no true blacks, colour close to grey, the far bank a suggestion. The air is the subject.
simpler_description_vi: Một buổi sáng sương lạnh vẫn được giữ đúng chất sương: không có đen tuyệt đối, màu gần như xám, bờ xa chỉ còn là gợi ý. Không khí mới là chủ thể.
current_description: Cold humid morning on water, where the far bank is a suggestion rather than a line. Everything that would give the picture an edge is taken away so the film's own blue can be the subject: nothing in the frame goes fully black, colour is held close to grey, and the air between you and the far side is left in. Nothing darkens at the corners, because mist has no edge.

name: Late Supper 800
occasion_en: For the end of a good dinner.
occasion_vi: Cho đoạn cuối của một bữa tối ngon.
simpler_description_en: A table at the end of the night: sauce stays red, broth stays gold, the room reads warm instead of orange, with a fine indoor grain.
simpler_description_vi: Chiếc bàn lúc cuối đêm: sốt vẫn đỏ, nước dùng vẫn vàng, căn phòng ấm nhưng không bị cam quá mức, kèm lớp hạt mịn trong nhà.
current_description: A table at the end of the night, lit by whatever bulbs the room has. Sauce stays red and broth stays gold while the cold end of the spectrum is pushed out of the way, which is what makes a warm room read as warm rather than orange. The headroom is spent on the white of a bowl, and the correction stopped a shade short so the food does not turn. The grain is there the way a fast film's is indoors — present, not coarse.

name: Night Market 800
occasion_en: For steam, bulbs and crowded stalls.
occasion_vi: Cho hơi nước, bóng đèn và những quầy hàng đông đúc.
simpler_description_en: The loud night out: dark stays dark between the stalls, bulbs flare, colour runs free, coarse grain. Made for mixed, messy light.
simpler_description_vi: Một đêm thật ồn ào: khoảng tối giữa các quầy vẫn tối, bóng đèn lóe sáng, màu sắc bung tự do, hạt thô hiện rõ. Sinh ra cho thứ ánh sáng pha trộn và lộn xộn.
current_description: The same stock outdoors and loud. The dark between stalls is left dark, what the bulbs reach is opened right up, and the bulbs themselves are allowed to flare. The picture is softened for smoke and humid air, and the colour is let run further than anywhere else here. Mixed light is assumed — tungsten, fluorescent and LED in one frame — so the balance sits between them rather than on any one. The grain is coarse, as it is on any fast film pushed into a dark street.

name: Still Air 100
occasion_en: For slow sunny streets.
occasion_vi: Cho những con phố đầy nắng nhưng chậm rãi.
simpler_description_en: Sun-warmed streets gone quiet: skies settling grey-blue, brick deepening to dusky red, a fine grain over everything. Give it a little extra light.
simpler_description_vi: Những con phố được nắng sưởi rồi lặng đi: bầu trời ngả xanh xám, gạch đỏ sâu hơn, một lớp hạt mịn phủ toàn khung hình. Hợp khi cho thêm một chút sáng.
current_description: Memoir Chrome with the blue drawn out and a light grain laid on. A clear sky settles to a soft grey-blue and a white cloud turns to cream, while brick and terracotta deepen to a dusky red and glass goes teal. Colour runs a little fuller than the film's own, but the brightest parts are held well back and the picture sits on the dim side, so it wants more light than the scene seems to need. Edges and fine detail are softened, and a light, fine grain lies over everything, with a faint glow at bright edges and corners darkened barely at all.

name: Ordinary Day 200
occasion_en: For nothing special.
occasion_vi: Cho những ngày chẳng có gì đặc biệt.
simpler_description_en: Everyday life a shade brighter and cleaner than it felt: fresh greens, warm skin, open shade, and a light, fine grain.
simpler_description_vi: Cuộc sống thường ngày sáng và sạch hơn cảm giác thực tế một chút: xanh tươi, da ấm, bóng râm mở và một lớp hạt nhẹ, mịn.
current_description: Diary Neg with the colour turned up and the shadows opened. Greens and yellows come forward fresh and lively, reds stay a deep crimson, a blue sky still lightens toward cyan, and skin keeps its warmth. The whole frame is nudged a shade warmer, the dark end lifts so the shade under trees reads as soft grey rather than black, and the bright parts stay bright and clear. A light, fine grain lies over everything: a clean everyday picture, a touch soft, with only a faint glow and the lightest darkening at the corners.

name: Midnight Club 100
occasion_en: For the last photo of the night.
occasion_vi: Cho tấm ảnh cuối cùng của đêm.
simpler_description_en: The flash snapshot at the end of dinner: cream walls, golden skin, deep blacks, and a glow wherever the light lands hardest.
simpler_description_vi: Một cú flash cuối bữa tối: tường màu kem, da vàng ấm, vùng đen sâu, và quầng sáng xuất hiện ở nơi ánh đèn chạm mạnh nhất.
current_description: Butter Neg aimed at a face lit hard from the camera in a small room at night — the snapshot from the end of a dinner. Walls, menus and a white shirt go cream, skin turns golden, and the bright patch where the light lands on a cheek or a forehead is eased down rather than burnt white. Reds on a sign keep their weight, a dark jacket reads as navy, and the black stays deep with a cool edge. The picture is a touch soft under a light, fine grain, with a glow on whatever the light hits hardest and corners that darken the way a room falls away behind someone.

name: Shoebox 400
occasion_en: For photos that should look found.
occasion_vi: Cho những bức ảnh trông như vừa được tìm thấy.
simpler_description_en: A roll left in a drawer for years: dusty colour, a pinkish-grey sky, soft grain. Nothing looks new; it looks found.
simpler_description_vi: Một cuộn film nằm quên trong ngăn kéo nhiều năm: màu phủ bụi, bầu trời xám pha hồng, hạt mềm. Không gì trông mới — mọi thứ đều như vừa được tìm thấy.
current_description: Diary Neg as a roll left too long in a drawer. Colour thins to a dusty, faded echo of itself, a white sky sinks to a warm pinkish grey and pale walls take on a faint lilac, while the darks stay dark. The brightest parts sag instead of shining, so the whole picture sits dim and flat unless it is given plenty of light. Detail goes soft, and a light, soft-edged grain lies over everything, with a soft glow around bright edges and corners gently darkened. Nothing looks new; it looks found.

name: 1998 Neg
occasion_en: For summers you were too young to photograph.
occasion_vi: Cho những mùa hè khi bạn còn quá nhỏ để tự chụp.
simpler_description_en: A late-nineties summer: warm with a faint olive cast, rich reds, soft browns instead of black. Give it a bit more light than the camera asks.
simpler_description_vi: Một mùa hè cuối thập niên 90: ấm với chút olive, đỏ đậm, đen chuyển thành nâu mềm. Hợp khi tăng sáng hơn máy gợi ý một chút.
current_description: Afterglow Neg as a snapshot from a late-nineties summer. The whole picture leans warm with a faint olive tinge, so a cream wall turns khaki, brown paper goes golden and a pale window frame goes sage, while red flowers and warm colours stay full and rich. The darks lift to a soft brown-grey instead of black and the bright parts glow without going harsh, so the frame reads gentle rather than punchy. Edges and fine detail are softened, and a light, fine grain lies over everything, with a faint glow at bright edges and corners gently darkened.

name: Folio 100
occasion_en: For ordinary days done gently.
occasion_vi: Cho những ngày bình thường theo cách thật dịu dàng.
simpler_description_en: A quiet summer roll: pale skies, softly faded colour, clean whites, a fine grain. Everyday days, gently printed.
simpler_description_vi: Một cuộn film mùa hè yên tĩnh: trời nhạt, màu phai nhẹ, trắng sạch, hạt mịn. Những ngày thường được in ra thật dịu.
current_description: Lost Summer Neg as an everyday summer roll. Colour stays quiet and slightly faded: a clear blue sky pales almost to a soft grey, green roofs go grey-teal, a red shopfront turns toward vermilion and a pink wall toward salmon, while white walls stay clean with only a faint warmth. The tones sit soft and even, with bright walls held back from glare and the shadows opened a little, and edges and fine detail are softened, with a light, fine grain over everything. A faint glow sits at bright edges and the corners are gently darkened.

name: City Neg 400
occasion_en: For markets, lanterns and full streets.
occasion_vi: Cho chợ, đèn lồng và những con phố đông người.
simpler_description_en: A warm city afternoon at full colour: deep reds, golden skin, soft pale skies, doorways keeping their shadow. A fine city grain over it all.
simpler_description_vi: Một buổi chiều thành phố ấm và đầy màu: đỏ sâu, da vàng ấm, bầu trời nhạt mềm, ô cửa vẫn giữ được bóng tối. Phủ lên tất cả là lớp hạt thành thị mịn.
current_description: Lost Summer Neg pushed toward a warm city afternoon. Colour runs full: red cloth and lanterns go a deep, rich red, skin turns warm and golden, and awnings, fruit and signs keep their weight, while a clear sky pales to a soft, warm grey and the strong blue chrome holds blue shirts and signs dark. The brightest parts are pulled well back so white walls and sky never glare, and the shadows sit a step deeper, so doorways and shopfronts keep their weight. Fine detail is softened a little, edges keep their bite, and a light, fine grain lies over everything, with a faint glow at bright edges and corners gently darkened.

name: Underpass 400
occasion_en: For one face under strip lights.
occasion_vi: Cho một gương mặt dưới ánh đèn tuýp.
simpler_description_en: Night-green corridors and one warm face: the tiles go green, skin goes olive-gold, and the corners darken like the edge of a film frame.
simpler_description_vi: Những hành lang xanh về đêm và một gương mặt ấm: gạch men chuyển xanh, da ngả olive-vàng, còn các góc tối lại như mép của một khung film.
current_description: Olive Neg aimed at a person under strip lights after dark — a subway passage, a stairwell, a late corridor. Walls, tiles and the floor go green, the dark parts stay green with them, and the face turns yellow and olive-gold with a small shine where the light catches it, standing warm against the room. A brown jacket keeps its richness, blacks stay deep, and the brightest light eases into a pale cream instead of a hard white. The picture opens soft and a little flat under a light, fine grain, with a faint glow on the lights and corners that darken like the edge of a film frame.

name: Kiosk Flash 400
occasion_en: For faces at arm's length after dark.
occasion_vi: Cho những gương mặt trong tầm tay khi trời đã tối.
simpler_description_en: A pocket-camera flash snapshot: the face and whatever is nearest come up bright and clean, a white shirt goes fully white, and the dark behind takes a green cast.
simpler_description_vi: Một tấm ảnh flash kiểu máy bỏ túi: gương mặt và những gì ở gần nhất sáng và sạch, áo trắng trắng hẳn, còn khoảng tối phía sau ngả xanh lục.
current_description: Kiosk Neg with a flash fired close to a person — the pocket-camera snapshot. The face and whatever is nearest come up bright and clean, a white shirt goes fully white, and the dark behind them takes a green cast. Reds stay rich, blue leans teal, and skin keeps close to its own colour. A fine grain sits over the frame, with a light darkening at the corners.
